name: comp-509
title: Three Month Range Calendar
blurb: Three-month calendar view for spanning longer date ranges.
description: Displays three consecutive months in range mode, laid out responsively (stacked on mobile, side-by-side on desktop). Paged navigation moves through months. Separator lines divide the calendars.
use_when: Users need to select spans across three months, such as quarterly date ranges.
avoid_when: Mobile devices with limited screen width — three months may stack awkwardly.
a11y: Keyboard-accessible calendar navigation. aria-live for date selection announcements.
